info.name: Xcel Energy Green Button Connect My Data ApplicationInformation Authorization API
List customer authorizations granted to the application

params.name: published-min
params.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry published timestamp, in epoch seconds or ISO 8601.

params.name: published-max
params.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry published timestamp, in epoch seconds or ISO 8601.

params.name: updated-min
params.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry updated timestamp.

params.name: updated-max
params.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry updated timestamp.

params.name: max-results
params.description: Maximum number of entries to return in the feed.

params.name: start-index
params.description: 1-based index of the first entry to return for paginated feeds.

items.docs: Returns an Atom feed of Authorization entries granted by retail customers to the calling third-party application.

params.name: authorizationId
params.description: Identifier of an Authorization granted by a retail customer.

items.docs: Returns the Authorization entry identified by authorizationId.
